lines.gurmukhi: ਤਟਨ ਖਟਨ ਜਟਨ ਹੋਮਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੰਡਧਾਰ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tatan khatan jatan homan naahee da(n)dadhaar suaau ||1||
lines.translation: Making pilgrimages to sacred rivers, observing the six rituals, wearing matted and tangled hair, performing fire sacrifices and carrying ceremonial walking sticks - none of these are of any use. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਭਾਂਤਨ ਤਪਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਥਨ ਕਥਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jatan bhaa(n)tan tapan bhraman anik kathan kathate nahee thaah paaee thaau ||
lines.translation: All sorts of efforts, austerities, wanderings and various speeches - none of these will lead you to find the Lord's Place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਿ ਸਗਰ ਸੋਧਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: sodh sagar sodhanaa sukh naanakaa bhaj naau ||2||2||39||
lines.translation: I have considered all considerations, O Nanak, but peace comes only by vibrating and meditating on the Name. ||2||2||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ghar 9 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Ninth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲੁ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan bhagat bachhal bhai haran taaran taran ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear - He carries us across to the other side. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਤਿਪਤੇ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਜਸੁ ਤੋਖਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਰਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nain tipate daras pekh jas tokh sunat karan ||1||
lines.translation: My eyes are satisfied, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; my ears are satisfied, hearing His Praise. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੀਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: praan naath anaath daate deen gobid saran ||
lines.translation: He is the Master of the praanaa, the breath of life; He is the Giver of Support to the unsupported. I am meek and poor - I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਗਹੀ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: aas pooran dukh binaasan gahee ot naanak har charan ||2||1||40||
lines.translation: He is the Fulfiller of hope, the Destroyer of pain. Nanak grasps the Support of the Feet of the Lord. ||2||1||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan saran daiaal thaakur aan naahee jaai ||
lines.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the Feet of my Merciful Lord and Master; I do not go anywhere else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਉਧਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan birad suaamee udharate har dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It is the Inherent Nature of our Lord and Master to purify sinners. Those who meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੈਸਾਰ ਗਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਪਤਿਤ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਅੰਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: saisaar gaar bikaar saagar patit moh maan a(n)dh ||
lines.translation: The world is a swamp of wickedness and corruption. The blind sinner has fallen into the ocean of emotional attachment and pride,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਕਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਧੰਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikal maaiaa sa(n)g dha(n)dh ||
lines.translation: bewildered by the entanglements of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahe prabh aap kaadhahu raakh lehu gobi(n)d raai ||1||
lines.translation: God Himself has taken me by the hand and lifted me up and out of it; save me, O Sovereign Lord of the Universe. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: anaath naath sanaath sa(n)tan kot paap binaas ||
lines.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, the Supporting Lord of the Saints, the Neutralizer of millions of sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨੈ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: man darasanai kee piaas ||
lines.translation: My mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਨਤਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh pooran gunataas ||
lines.translation: God is the Perfect Treasure of Virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: kripaal daiaal gupaal naanak har rasanaa gun gaai ||2||2||41||
lines.translation: O Nanak, sing and savor the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Kind and Compassionate Lord of the World. ||2||2||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਉ ਅਨਿਕ ਡਾਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaar vaarau anik daarau ||
lines.translation: Countless times, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਪਲਕ ਰਾਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh pri suhaag palak raat ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: to that moment of peace, on that night when I was joined with my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਮੰਦਰ ਪਾਟ ਸੇਜ ਸਖੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਤਾਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kanik ma(n)dar paat sej sakhee mohi naahi in siu taat ||1||
lines.translation: Mansions of gold, and beds of silk sheets - O sisters, I have no love for these. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤ ਲਾਲ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat laal anik bhog bin naam naanak haat ||
lines.translation: Pearls, jewels and countless pleasures, O Nanak, are useless and destructive without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਖੋ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭੂਮਿ ਸੈਨ ਸਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਤ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: rookho bhojan bhoom sain sakhee pri sa(n)g sookh bihaat ||2||3||42||
lines.translation: Even with only dry crusts of bread, and a hard floor on which to sleep, my life passes in peace and pleasure with my Beloved, O sisters. ||2||3||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰ ਤੋਰੋ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n) toro mukh joro ||
lines.translation: Give up your ego, and turn your face to God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur gur karat man loro ||
lines.translation: Let your yearning mind call out, "Guru, Guru".

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਮੋਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pri preet piaaro moro ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My Beloved is the Lover of Love. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਆਗਨਿ ਚੈਨਾ ਤੋਰੋ ਰੀ ਤੋਰੋ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੋਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: grihi sej suhaavee aagan chainaa toro ree toro pa(n)ch dootan siu sa(n)g toro ||1||
lines.translation: The bed of your household shall be cozy, and your courtyard shall be comfortable; shatter and break the bonds which tie you to the five thieves. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨਿ ਊਂਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਸੋਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: aai na jaai base nij aasan oo(n)dh kamal bigasoro ||
lines.translation: You shall not come and go in reincarnation; you shall dwell in your own home deep within, and your inverted heart-lotus shall blossom forth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੁਟਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhutakee haumai soro ||
lines.translation: The turmoil of egotism shall be silenced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਗਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰੋ ॥੨॥੪॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: gaaio ree gaaio prabh naanak gunee gahero ||2||4||43||
lines.translation: Nanak sings - he sings the Praises of God, the Ocean of Virtue. ||2||4||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਃ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mah 5 ghar 9 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Ninth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਜਾਪਿ ਮਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa(n) te jaap manaa har jaap ||
lines.translation: This is why you should chant and meditate on the Lord, O mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੰਤ ਬੇਦ ਕਹਤ ਪੰਥੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਅਹੰ ਤਾਪ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sa(n)t bed kahat pa(n)th gaakharo moh magan aha(n) taap || rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Vedas and the Saints say that the path is treacherous and difficult. You are intoxicated with emotional attachment and the fever of egotism. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo raate maate sa(n)g bapuree maaiaa moh sa(n)taap ||1||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued and intoxicated with the wretched Maya, suffer the pains of emotional attachment. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਊ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਹੁ ਆਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam japat sooo jan udharai jisahi udhaarahu aap ||
lines.translation: That humble being is saved, who chants the Naam; You Yourself save him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੋਹ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੫॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: binas jaai moh bhai bharamaa naanak sa(n)t prataap ||2||5||44||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment, fear and doubt are dispelled, O Nanak, by the Grace of the Saints. ||2||5||44||
